evidence.title: Expose source-authorized superseded Timeline Entry status through the existing Case HTTP read
evidence.goal: Mark an older authorized Case Timeline Entry non-current when and only when another authorized visible version supersedes it, reusing the existing read-only owner projection and HTTP route. No mutation, owner transfer, or new data source.
outputs: Authorized superseded predecessors are explicitly flagged in the existing Case Timeline JSON response, including paginated and filtered reads without a new endpoint.
Positive and denied-source Go projection/HTTP regression proof, preserving original version links and limiting inference.
acceptance_tests: Source-authorized version1 and version2 where version2 supersedes version1 must mark only version1 as superseded.
Multi-hop authorized version chain marks all old nodes without manufacturing a single canonical successor.
Denied, missing and foreign successor must never change the visible predecessor flag or disclose its ID.
Explicit HTTP request with Case bearer shows boolean for predecessor even when newer entry is on another authorized page; invalid/revoked Case denied.
Existing Go tests and relevant GitHub Actions succeed on the exact SHA, no claims of production auth.
